product_constraint: 1.5x-3x same-request committed Decode with exact state/logits/output, configured draft maxima 2/3 and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.
mechanism: Request-local acceptance-driven draft budget starts at configured maximum 2/3, decreases by one to minimum one after rejection, increases by one to configured maximum after full acceptance. Tail cap remains remaining_output-1. No confidence kernel, offline length scan or new arithmetic.

reference_translation.scope: HF describes acceptance-history heuristic and confidence-driven alternative, with workload-dependent outcomes. vLLM separately supports batch-size-conditioned lookahead. Translate only bounded adaptive work selection; no source import or guaranteed speedup.

equivalence_ledger: Budget is fixed before transaction begin; begin/verify use the same effective row count.
Configured public length remains 2/3; adaptive effective count is 1..configured maximum, or zero for final one-token tail.
Every shorter round uses already exact M2/M3/M4/scalar-tail operators. Rejections/cancel/EOS still commit complete target prefix before observer.
Budget belongs to one decode call and resets at each request; no carry across cancellation or recovery.
Record proposal-length histogram; verify weighted count and logical/physical receipts. Work counts may change; output IDs must remain identical.
No target/draft arithmetic, Prefill, allocation, capacity or reserve change.
gates: host controller dynamic-budget/state replay and invalid-budget tests
full real P65 prefixes plus mixed-budget transactions/recovery
immediate d2 API P65/8K/40K; >3% slowdown stops, useful direction unlocks d3, otherwise remove
expiry: One configured-max-2/3 API composition. No heuristic/threshold scan; useful policy is dependency-only through next full API composition or archival.
